title: A Note on Iterated Beatty Sequences
summary: For any irrational number $ α>\frac{3+\sqrt{5}}{2}\approx2.618$ and given a positive $ n\in\mathbb{N} $, we use elementary number theory to introduce a necessary and sufficient condition for a natural number $ x $ to be in the $n$th iterate of the Beatty sequence of modulus $α$.
